title: Ask about a deal deleted mid-conversation
userProblem: I asked about deal dls_005 earlier but it has been removed since. Tell me what stage it was in and its amount.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches, finds the deal no longer exists, and reports that truthfully without inventing a stage or amount.

assertions.description: Agent must search for dls_005 rather than inventing an answer.
No invented stage, amount or title for the removed deal.
Answer must report the deal is gone.
Trace must follow the read-lookup shape.

rationale: Tests that a removed record is not confabulated. Latent bug surface: scn-core-030 (hallucinated fallback) - with the bug on the app synthesises a plausible fake record instead of not-found. Hardened mode passes.
